extracted.intended_audience: scholars, prospective/past Ford Fellows, higher-education stakeholders, philanthropic partners, and the broader public interested in Ford Foundation funding priorities
extracted.subtask_description: Announcement and explanation of the Ford Foundation's decision to sunset its long-running Ford Fellowships administered by the National Academies, describing rationale, timeline, and funding commitments. The page communicates funding-priority criteria and procedural commitments related to the program's phase-out.

rubrics_metrics.name: Three I's of social change
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation centers work on three priorities: Individuals, their ideas, and institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This framing guides what the Foundation supports — courageous leaders (individuals), bold visions (ideas), and the dynamism/durability of movements and organizations (institutions). Use this triad as a guiding lens when considering alignment with Ford's funding choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritize support for individuals, especially from historically marginalized communities
rubrics_metrics.description: Longstanding investment in rising scholars 'particularly from and within historically marginalized communities.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Fellowship program historically focused on helping scholars from underrepresented groups pursue research and advance within academia; this demographic focus was a core criterion for selecting and justifying support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diversify leadership in higher education as a programmatic goal
rubrics_metrics.description: A specific objective of the Foundation's higher-education investments has been to diversify academic leadership and tenured positions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program impact is measured in part by progress toward diversifying leadership and changing the face and function of the academy via scholarship and mentorship.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recalibrate funding toward traditionally underfunded social and racial justice work
rubrics_metrics.description: Shift resources away from areas where other funders lead and toward movement-building and racial justice advocacy that receive a fraction of equity funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When philanthropic landscape shows sufficient leadership/funding in an area (e.g., K-12 and higher education led by Gates, Lumina, etc.), consider stepping back and redirecting support to more underfunded domains; prioritize investments that catalyze social/racial justice movement-building.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid duplicating other philanthropic efforts — consider landscape and comparative need
rubrics_metrics.description: Decisions to step back from certain program areas were informed by recognition that other institutions were leading in meaningful ways and that philanthropic support for education was increasing overall.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess the broader philanthropic ecosystem and funding levels when deciding whether to continue or end a program; if others are already providing robust support, redeploy resources to unmet needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to an orderly sunset with protections for current awardees
rubrics_metrics.description: The Foundation adopted a sunset plan: wind down the Ford Fellowships program by 2028, award a new round in 2023, make a limited number of awards in 2024, and continue support for all currently awarded Ford Fellows through the end of their fellowship terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When ending a program, ensure clear timeline, limited final award rounds, and explicit guarantees that current awardees receive their promised support without change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptability of difficult trade-offs and transparency about decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledges the painful nature of stepping away from a long-running commitment and that some stakeholders may disagree with the judgment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be transparent about the rationale for funding shifts, acknowledge trade-offs, and communicate respect for disagreement; explain the strategic reasons (e.g., to better address defining crises such as inequality).

rubrics_metrics.name: Continue accountability expectations for higher-education institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Although the Foundation is winding down fellowship funding, it asserts the need to hold higher-education institutions accountable for lack of diversity in tenured and leadership positions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain emphasis on institutional accountability as a criterion for evaluating the broader progress toward equity even when philanthropic funding priorities shift.
